archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) infused with Pulse Branding

core_principles: Heritage Meets Tech: Combine the 45-year manufacturing legacy of Pulse Fitness with modern SaaS portal capabilities.
High-End Hardware Aesthetic: Use large, edge-to-edge photography, bento box grids for data, and stark typography. Avoid generic SaaS 'flatness'.
Trust & Reliability: Highlight the 95.5% first-time fix rate and MOD partnerships prominently.
Pulse Cyan as Action: Use the signature #66ccff almost exclusively for interactive elements and key data highlights, resting against a monochrome structural palette.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Use py-24 to py-32 for section padding. Use gap-8 to gap-12 for bento grids.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol. Strict column alignment. Grid children must stretch to fill cells.

surface_styles.bento_card: bg-white rounded-xl border border-pulse-grey-light/20 shadow-sm p-8 flex flex-col justify-between hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
surface_styles.dark_card: bg-pulse-black rounded-xl border border-white/10 p-8 text-white

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Examples: data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='login-modal-trigger'.

page_sections.name: Sticky Header
page_sections.guidelines: z-50 fixed top-0 w-full glassmorphism style. Left: Logo. Center: Nav anchors. Right: Theme toggle, Language, Sign In Button (data-testid='nav-login-btn').

page_sections.name: Hero
page_sections.guidelines: Full height (min-h-[90vh]). Background image: hero-heart-of-fitness.webp with bg-pulse-black/40 overlay. Content left-aligned: 'Pulse Fitness Self-Service Portal'. Primary CTA 'Get Started' and Secondary 'Login'. Floating live-stats preview card aligned right.

page_sections.name: Trusted By / Partnerships (NEW)
page_sections.guidelines: A sleek, low-contrast grayscale logo strip below the hero. Since image logos are not provided, use clean typographic logos with distinct fonts (e.g., 'MINISTRY OF DEFENCE', 'THIRD SPACE', 'IMPERIAL COLLEGE', 'LEISURE UNITED') using text-pulse-grey-light font-black tracking-widest.

page_sections.name: Heritage Story: 45 Years of Innovation (NEW)
page_sections.guidelines: Scroll-triggered vertical timeline. 1980 (Foundations) -> 2019 (TRAKK) -> 2025 (Cirrus V4). Use trakk-connected.webp and product-crosstrainer.webp overlapping the timeline path. Text must convey engineering legacy.

page_sections.name: Company & Service Stats Bento (NEW)
page_sections.guidelines: Dense, Control-Room style grid. Highlight: '30K+ R&D hours', '48hr response', '95.5% first-time fix rate'. One grid cell should feature gym-interior-cardio.webp with a dark overlay and '450+ Products' metric. Use Pulse Cyan for the large numbers.

page_sections.name: What You Can Do (Capabilities Grid)
page_sections.guidelines: Keep functional grid. Feature woman-strength.webp in a span-2 tall bento card. Clean iconography (lucide-react). Focus on fault-logging and asset management.

page_sections.name: AI Features & Ask Orb
page_sections.guidelines: Keep existing mock. Surround with generous padding. Use subtle cyan drop-shadow to make the orb 'glow'.

page_sections.name: How it Works
page_sections.guidelines: 3-step process. Simple typography, heavy emphasis on frictionless UX.

page_sections.name: Gamified Experience
page_sections.guidelines: Keep wizard mock. Render inside a stylized browser or phone frame.

page_sections.name: Gym Floor Showcase
page_sections.guidelines: Background: strength-floor.webp. Foreground: Interactive phone frame demonstrating QR scan -> log fault steps.

page_sections.name: Mobile Experience (Dark Section)
page_sections.guidelines: Invert theme to dark mode for this section. bg-pulse-black. Deep cinematic feel. Feature gym-orange-lights.webp.

page_sections.name: Sustainability & Engineering (NEW)
page_sections.guidelines: Highlight 100% recycled steel, 90% strength recycling. Layout: split 50/50. Text on left, leisure-centre-aerial.webp on right with an embedded grid of product_bike.webp and product_cable_machine.webp.

page_sections.name: Customer Benefits
page_sections.guidelines: Focus on ROI for gym owners, equipment uptime, and member satisfaction.

page_sections.name: Support
page_sections.guidelines: Reinforce in-house UK service team and flexible service contracts.

page_sections.name: Lite vs Pro Plans
page_sections.guidelines: Pricing/Tier cards. Pro tier gets a subtle 'tracing beam' or cyan border glow.

page_sections.name: Tailored to Your Gym
page_sections.guidelines: Use gym-treadmill-row.webp as a wide banner graphic.

page_sections.name: Final CTA
page_sections.guidelines: Use gym-interior-sleek.webp with heavy dark overlay. Massive typography: 'Ready to elevate your equipment management?'.

page_sections.name: Footer
page_sections.guidelines: Standard SaaS footer, dark theme (bg-pulse-black). Includes global distribution note (35+ dealers, 30+ countries).

page_sections.name: Login Modal
page_sections.guidelines: Keep existing functional modal. Apply Pulse styling (cyan buttons, clean borders). MUST include data-testid='login-submit-btn'.

components_instructions.buttons: Square or rounded-md (max 6px). Primary: bg-pulse-primary text-pulse-black font-bold. Hover: bg-pulse-primary-hover.
components_instructions.cards: 1px border border-pulse-grey-light/20. No aggressive drop shadows, prefer crisp minimalist borders.
components_instructions.animations: Use Framer Motion. Keep animations to opacity fades and slight y-axis translations (translate-y-4) on scroll. No excessive bouncy spring animations.
